name: The Character Advancement (GM) Learn and (GM) Unlearn menu entries teach and remove an entry at no cost
contract: Run on a free-pick realm (CoA.ClassModel = hero). Ascension's CharacterAdvancement.lua gives a GM two spell menu entries: (GM) Learn sends ".ca2 player addentry <name> <entry>" and (GM) Unlearn sends ".ca2 player removeentry <name> <entry>". The server had no ca2 command, so both did nothing.

addentry teaches the entry at its highest rank, past its level, essence and tab requirements, without charging anything. Improved Heroic Strike (entry 40351, ranks 12282/12663/12664) and the level-30 Mortal Strike (entry 40362, spell 12294) are taught to a level 10 Hero. removeentry takes the entry and all its rank spells away, again free. The client is sent its known entries after each change.
Players below Game Master security cannot use either command, and removing an entry the character does not know is refused.

An entry the build grants automatically at no cost, such as Judgement of Light (entry 18443, spell 1120271), cannot be removed: the next build check would grant it again, so removeentry refuses it and the spell stays. The scenario teaches it with addentry first, since a level 10 Hero does not yet qualify for it.

steps.label: Let login hooks settle
SETUP: Improved Heroic Strike is not known
SETUP: Mortal Strike is not known
Known-entries packets before
(GM) Learn Improved Heroic Strike
THE FIX: Improved Heroic Strike is learned at rank 3
Lower ranks are not kept alongside it
(GM) Learn the level-30 Mortal Strike at level 10
THE FIX: Mortal Strike is learned past its level
The client is sent its known entries
Nothing was charged
(GM) Unlearn Improved Heroic Strike
THE FIX: Improved Heroic Strike is gone
Mortal Strike is kept
Unlearning was free
Removing an entry the character does not know is refused
(GM) Learn Judgement of Light, an automatic entry
SETUP: Judgement of Light is known
THE FIX: removing an automatically granted entry is refused
Judgement of Light is still known
A player without GM security cannot use it
The player did not learn Mortal Strike
